description: Classification rules for observed GraphQL responses. Resource expectations come from the test case, not benchmark configuration names.

outcomes.allow: PASS only when target and required property evidence is present; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
outcomes.deny_object: POLICY_VIOLATION when the target object is returned; PASS only for a selected, explicit denial response without relevant errors; missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
outcomes.deny_property: POLICY_VIOLATION when a selected restricted property has a non-null value; PASS when selected and null without relevant errors; missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
outcomes.inconclusive: Always classify as INCONCLUSIVE because the case itself declares evidence insufficient.

verdicts.PASS: Observed response satisfies the expected access policy.
verdicts.POLICY_VIOLATION: Observed response contains the seeded unauthorized object or restricted property.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is insufficient or cannot be reliably classified.
